title: kbgit.py knows its remotes by role
goal: kbgit.py and backlog.py red-pipeline read the integration remote from git config kb.integration (default origin) and the publish remote from kb.publish (unset: no publishing); sync, publish and the hooks use the roles, --remote still overrides; no host name or url appears in _tools; tests.py -k remote_roles covers a clone with and without a publish remote

gates.question: Where does a clone record its remote roles?
options: git config keys kb.integration and kb.publish (per clone, never committed)
remote names fixed by convention (origin, public)
gates.recommendation: git config keys kb.integration and kb.publish (per clone, never committed)
